classification: post-confirmation explanatory diagnostic; no change to the confirmed generality gate
question: At the same resident matching and investment state, which corrected rare-mutant investment-gradient components change when assurance capacity is increased, and is that direct effect different under near versus far visitor histories?
gradient: Corrected fixed-resident rare-mutant log-invasion gradient from scripts/model3_island/selection.py; resident pollen pool and recipient competition are held fixed.

estimands.assurance_effect_within_arm: investment gradient at assurance 0.75 minus investment gradient at assurance 0.25, computed within each visitor history and arm
estimands.near_minus_far_assurance_effect: assurance effect in near minus assurance effect in far for the matched visitor-history seed
estimands.component_contributions: The same high-minus-low assurance contrast for each gradient component.

reporting_rules.report_all: Retain all three snapshots and all four settings regardless of sign.
reporting_rules.no_dynamic_mediation: This fixed-resident diagnostic explains local selection only and cannot by itself identify the finite-trajectory attenuation as a mediation effect.
reporting_rules.direct_vs_feedback: If the near-minus-far assurance effect is negative, direct local coupling is stronger on the near side; any mismatch with trajectory-level arm effects is evidence that dynamic ecological/genetic feedback also matters.
reporting_rules.sensitivity_boundary: The previously completed 500-combination parameter grid contains rare positive capacity-to-investment cross-effect exceptions; no universal sign is claimed outside the baseline settings.
